verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Qualcomm's site serves a working llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a short company description, so an agent can be pointed at it, but developer docs in markdown (developer.md) and API/OpenAPI specs 404, and the actual product spec page is a JS-only shell unreadable to non-browser fetchers. missing for 10: markdown-rendered developer docs, machine-readable API specs, agent-readable product spec pages.
